title: Women Delay Medical Care Due to Cost Concerns
discussion_signal: KFF’s post makes the household tradeoff concrete: cost can lead women to postpone tests or treatment, not fill prescriptions, or alter doses. It adds a direct care-behavior signal to the atlas record’s broader connection among coverage, affordability, medication, and household necessities.
linked_research_question: How do women’s health discussions show affordability becoming a choice among care, medication, and basic household needs?
limits: Self-reported tradeoffs do not establish clinical outcomes
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative patient sample
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
